known_blockers: The user-owned PS3 BO2 .ff fastfiles are authenticated/encrypted TAff0100 containers. This project intentionally does not bypass that encryption; payload conversion requires user-provided legally decrypted/normalized fastfile data.
Format-specific IPAK texture decoding, BO2 mesh/map decoding, skeletal animation decoding, and audio-bank extraction remain to be implemented.
Physical iPhone installation/runtime validation has not yet been performed.
The SceneKit runtime is the validated bootstrap runtime; the final open-source-engine/runtime decision remains documented in ENGINE_DECISION.md.
